slot_scores.name: contract_full_coverage
slot_scores.evidence_quote: When a contract of length L is chosen, does it cover the full required area for each of its L months, or can it cover only part of the required area (with the rest covered by other contracts)?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent asked about full-area coverage versus partial-area coverage, which is related to contract coverage, but did not explicitly ask whether a signed contract must remain active for all months in its term.

slot_scores.name: contract_length_diversity
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never asked whether the plan must include at least two different contract lengths or whether a single contract type is acceptable.

slot_scores.name: max_distinct_contracts
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is the objective to minimize the total rental cost over the 4 months, and is there any other objective or constraint (such as a budget cap or a maximum number of warehouses) I should be aware of?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked about a maximum number of warehouses/contracts, and then clarified the cap in later turns.

slot_scores.name: demand_exact_satisfaction
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Can the total rented area in a given month exceed the required area for that month, or must it be exactly equal to the required area?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent directly asked whether monthly rented area must exactly equal required area or whether excess is allowed.

slot_scores.name: objective_minimize_cost
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is the objective to minimize the total rental cost over the 4 months, and is there any other objective or constraint (such as a budget cap or a maximum number of warehouses) I should be aware of?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly confirmed that the objective is to minimize total rental cost over the 4 months.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: The agent assumed there is no requirement to include at least two different contract lengths.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked about contract-length diversity, and the user simulator did not volunteer this constraint.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent stopped after resolving P0 slots but never asked about the P1 contract-length diversity requirement, leaving H2 unresolved.

summary: The agent recovered the core P0 demand and objective facts and clarified several structural details, but it missed the P1 contract-length diversity requirement and engaged in many repetitive low-value confirmation turns.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
